analysis_md:
方法一：因为 $\left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(1,2)}=\left.f'(4x^2-y^2)\cdot8x\right|_{(1,2)}=4$，

$\left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right|_{(1,2)}=\left.f'(4x^2-y^2)\cdot(-2y)\right|_{(1,2)}=-2$，

所以，$\left.dz\right|_{(1,2)}=\left[\left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(1,2)}dx+\left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right|_{(1,2)}dy\right]=4dx-2dy$。

方法二：对 $z=f(4x^2-y^2)$ 微分得

$dz=f'(4x^2-y^2)d(4x^2-y^2)=f'(4x^2-y^2)(8x\,dx-2y\,dy)$，

故 $\left.dz\right|_{(1,2)}=f'(0)(8dx-2dy)=4dx-2dy$。
